title: You don't have to have it all figured out (kite reel, vivid)

captions.instagram:
You don't have to have it all figured out. 🪁

Not by 25, not by 30, not by the next family function.
Plans change, and that isn't failing.
Today, pick one small next step and let the rest stay open.

Send this to someone who feels behind.

#selfgrowth #trustthejourney #mindfulness #emotionalwellness #soundmind
